instruction: Select the whole image, then expand the selection outward by 10 pixels.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'selection-grow-radius', default: '1.000000' } ] }); return data[0]; }
